summary: subelements produces a product of a list of objects and the values of a chosen subelement of each object, similar to the subelements lookup.
questions: How do I loop over users and each of their groups in Ansible?
Is there a filter equivalent to with_subelements?

answer_card.title: subelements filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ users | subelements('groups') }}` pairs each object with each value of its chosen subelement list, like the `subelements` lookup. Useful for nested loops such as users and their groups.
